svg.title: Compute efficiency vs data efficiency
svg.desc: Combinatorial BPE reaches standard BPE's final bits-per-byte with 30% less training compute and 3% less training data.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

svg.text: Compute efficiency vs data efficiency (mixed prose + code run)

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

svg.text: Validation bits per byte (lower is better) against training compute and against training text read. Same 8-layer GPT (modern recipe), same 32k embedding rows.

svg.text: FLOPs = 6 × forward multiply-adds per token × tokens; the combinatorial model costs ~5% more per token (larger output head) and is charged for it. Its savings are measured mid-schedule,

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

svg.text: before learning-rate decay, so they are conservative. Single seed.
